asked.item: Why Blotato tools don't load in Hermes (two mcp_servers keys in config)

verdict.reason: S54 and S55 state that a second mcpservers key makes the file invalid and Hermes keeps the previous config without Blotato, which matches the customer's file.

steps.text: Your config has a second mcp_servers key, and a second key makes the file invalid.
When that happens, Hermes keeps loading the previous configuration without Blotato, which is why only the github tools load.
If mcp_servers is already in the file, add only the blotato entry under it.
